newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA HITS YEAR-LOW ON EARNINGS DOUBTS.
newsitem.headline: MERITA HITS YEAR-LOW ON EARNINGS DOUBTS.

text.p: Finnish bank group Merita hit a new year-low on Monday, depressed by investors' continued doubts about its earnings prospects, brokers said.
At 1600/1300 GMT, Merita's vote strong A share traded at a new calendar year-low 9.26 markka, down 0.22 markka. But trade was a modest 3.0 million markka.

Brokers said Merita was also weighed by a report in daily Helsingin Sanomat on Monday which said KOP's top management may face charges related to the bank's share issue in 1994. Merita was formed in 1995 through the merger of Unitas and KOP.
